science_scope.P2_frozen: Delta-HAC8 crossed covariance, h1 factor sqrt((T−1)/T), t(R−1) exactly frozen as proposed control. No DM-HLN theorem or correction of strong-dependence variance failure claimed.
science_scope.crossed_linearization: Plug-in covariance seed+time is first-order crossed approximation; interaction may be counted twice in additive linearization, not a general upper bound. Nonlinear finite-calendar bias and degeneracy remain.
science_scope.known_bias: Different model temporal covariances can yield distinct finiteT square-root bias under equal longrun population RMSE; hetero-model phi is mandatory and its truth remains0. No postresult recentering to expected finitecalendar sample RMSE.
science_scope.moments: Squared errors need sufficiently high finite moments and inverse-MSE/derivative moments, or individual seed MSE bounded away fromzero, with seed-risk variation. Synthetic lognormal amplitudes and Gaussian AR factors have all positive and inverse amplitude moments, but no finite-R12 theorem is claimed.
science_scope.rates: A valid first-order argument additionally needs root-functional remainder and finite-calendar bias=o(contrastSE), consistent joint crossed studentizers, and bootstrap conditional pivot convergence. With order1/T bias and seed-dominated SE oforder1/sqrt(R), sqrt(R)/T->0 suffices for that bias term; if first-order seed/time projections degenerate, a different regime may be needed. No theorem establishing alltheseconditions for frozenR12T128 lag8block12 is claimed. M fixed20, not an increasing-model guarantee.
science_scope.sampling: Both seed and calendar axes; no conditioning change to finite observed calendar. IID exchangeable seed units independent of joint stationary calendar/factor process; models paired by seed and time.
science_scope.temporal: Joint stationarity, appropriate mixing and longrun covariance existence, common resampling indices for every seed/model. Standard consistency would require block length and HAC lag growing withT, block/T and lag/T tending0 plus appropriate moment/rate conditions. Here block12/lag8 fixed for bounded diagnostic only; no general consistency theorem is asserted for this setting.
